description: Fires when column 3 (the centre) holds an immediate four-completion, above all when the opponent has three stacked in column 3 with the cell above empty (strongest early in the game, at the bottom). Horizontal or diagonal win/block cells in column 3, my own immediate wins early on, and opponent vertical threes in columns 1 or 6 give weaker firing. Must-blocks in other columns mostly do not fire; crowded late boards damp it.
effect: Pushes the model to play column 3: forcing it to max sends column 3 to ~100% (e.g. 0.18->1.00, 0.41->1.00); zeroing it at a col-3 vertical block drops column 3 from 1.00 to 0.67.
notes: Best dev F1 0.437 (P 0.42, R 0.45, AUROC 0.72). Any must-block: F1 0.23; col-3 win/block only: 0.35; adding col-3 verticals with ply limits, side-column verticals and early own wins: 0.44. Minimal pairs: opp vertical three by column 0..6 = 1.0,4.3,0.6,51,-0.1,1.4,4.2; horizontal block at row 0 fires only when the cell is in col 3. Some early threat-free openings fire (2,6,2,2 = 9.9 vs 2,0,2,2 = -0.2), looking like a 'play column 3' output feature not captured by board rules. Simulation ceiling negative (share nan). Synthesis max 83.5 < dev max 97.4.
